description: map применяет parse_line к каждой непустой строке
code:
def parse_line(line):
    city, qty, unit = line.split(";")
    return [city, int(qty), int(unit)]

text = "Пермь;412;205\nКазань;538;198\n\nТюмень;297;214\n"
rows = list(map(parse_line, filter(None, text.splitlines())))
total = sum(qty * unit for _, qty, unit in rows)
print(rows, total)

description: Пропущена выручка последнего города
code:
def parse_line(line):
    city, cups, price = line.split(";")
    return [city, int(cups), int(price)]

text = "Пермь;412;205\nКазань;538;198\n\nТюмень;297;214\n"
total = 0
for line in text.split("\n"):
    if line.strip() != "":
        city, cups, price = parse_line(line)
        total += cups * price
total -= cups * price
print(total)

    (SELECT 1 FROM items i WHERE i.item_id=m.item_id)

description: Уникальные сессии через groupby и unstack
code:
import pandas as pd
f = pd.read_csv("app_funnel.csv", parse_dates=["ts"])
steps = ["открыл", "меню", "корзина", "оплата", "заказ"]
f["period"] = (f["ts"] >= "2026-06-15").map({True: "после 15.06", False: "до 15.06"})
pv = f.groupby(["platform", "period", "step"]).session_id.nunique().unstack()[steps]
conv = pv["заказ"] / pv["оплата"]
pay_conv = (conv * 100).round(1)
before, after = conv[("android", "до 15.06")], conv[("android", "после 15.06")]
lost = round(pv.loc[("android", "после 15.06"), "оплата"] * (before - after))
print(pay_conv)
print(lost)

description: Все промежуточные точки ROC сохранены, диагональ построена по четырём узлам
code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, roc_auc_score

g = pd.read_csv("guests_churn.csv")
y = g["churned"]
X = pd.get_dummies(g.drop(columns=["guest_id", "churned", "card_blocked"]), dtype=int).fillna({"avg_check": 0})
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)
p = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=0).fit(X_train, y_train).predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

fpr, tpr, thresholds = roc_curve(y_test, p, drop_intermediate=False)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 4.5))
ax.plot(fpr, tpr)
ax.plot([0, .25, .75, 1], [0, .25, .75, 1], "--")
ax.set_xlabel("FPR")
ax.set_ylabel("TPR")
ax.set_title("ROC-кривая леса")
auc = round(roc_auc_score(y_test, p), 3)
print("точек ROC", len(fpr), "AUC", auc, "диагональ", list(ax.lines[1].get_ydata()))

description: Коэффициент последнего флага фиксирован нулём, МНК по независимым столбцам
code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)]
y = ok["actual_min"].values
full = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(ok)), ok["distance_km"], pd.get_dummies(ok["courier"], dtype=int)])

w_a = np.r_[np.linalg.lstsq(full[:, :-1], y, rcond=None)[0], 0.]
w_b = w_a.copy()
w_b[0] += 10
w_b[2:] -= 10
max_diff = np.abs(full @ w_a - full @ w_b).max()
weights_differ = np.abs(w_a - w_b).max()
print(w_a, w_b, max_diff, weights_differ)

import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor, HistGradientBoostingRegressor, RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv", parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["hour"] = ok["created"].dt.hour
X = pd.get_dummies(ok[["distance_km", "items", "hour", "courier", "weather", "shop_id"]], dtype=int)
y = ok["actual_min"]
X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)

models = {
    "GradientBoosting": GradientBoostingRegressor(n_estimators=200, max_depth=3, random_state=0),
    "HistGradientBoosting": HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_iter=200, max_depth=3, random_state=0),
    "RandomForest": RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, min_samples_leaf=5, random_state=0),
}

rows = []
for name, model in models.items():
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
    fit_s = time.perf_counter() - t0

    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    pred = model.predict(X_te)
    predict_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000

    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_te, pred))
    rows.append({"model": name, "rmse": round(float(rmse), 3), "fit_s": fit_s, "predict_ms": predict_ms})

table = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("model").sort_values("rmse")
best = table.index[0]
fastest_fit = min(table.index, key=table["fit_s"].get)
print(table.round(3))
print("лучший:", best, "| быстрее всех обучился:", fastest_fit)

table = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("model").sort_values("rmse")
best = table.index[0]
fastest_fit = min(table.index, key=table["fit_s"].get)
print(table.round(3))
print("лучший:", best, "| быстрее всех обучился:", fastest_fit)

import pandas as pd

def range_problems(row):
    problems = []
    v = row["avg_check"]
    if not (pd.isna(v) or 50 <= v <= 3000):
        problems.append("avg_check: ожидается 50–3000 ₽ или пропуск")
    if not 0 <= row["delivery_share"] <= 1:
        problems.append("delivery_share: ожидается доля 0–1")
    if not row["visits_90d"] >= 0:
        problems.append("visits_90d: ожидается ≥ 0")
    return problems

bad = P.apply(lambda r: len(range_problems(r)) > 0, axis=1)
would_reject = bad.groupby(P["client"]).mean().round(3)
rejected_32 = int((bad & (P["client"] == "app 3.2")).sum())
first_bad = P.loc[bad, "ts"].min().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
print(would_reject, rejected_32, first_bad, sep="\n")
print("отрицательные визиты", range_problems(dict(avg_check=800, delivery_share=.5, visits_90d=-1)))
